newsitem.title: UK: United sells NORWEB to Lombard Tricity.
newsitem.headline: United sells NORWEB to Lombard Tricity.

text.p: United Utilities Plc said on Monday that Lombard Tricity Finance Lt (LTF) will be buying the loan portfolio of NORWEB Retail, a United Utilities business.

United said it will receive around 100 million stg in cash from Lombard Tricity Finance (LTF) at completion, with a further estimated 13 million of cash flow from the loan portfolio from the date of LTF financing new credit sales to the date of completion.
LTF will provide financing for new credit sales with effect from 11 November 1996 and will acquire at completion the balance of the loan portfolio outstanding.
United said the loan portfolio mainly comprises amounts receivable from customers of NORWEB Retail for sales of electrical goods made on credit.

The NORWEB Retail loan portfolio had an estimated book value of 110 million net of bad debt provision as at October 27 1996. At March 1996 the loan portfolio had a book value of 131 million net of bad debt provision.
It made operating profits of 9.5 million stg for the year ended 31 March 1996 of which 6.0 million relates to the period following the purchase of NORWEB Plc by United.
United said the sale proceeds will initially be used to reduce indebtedness.

Brian Staples, chief executive of United Utilities said, "This is a further significant disposal of non-core activities and brings the total raised from disposals to approximately 238 million towards our target of 350 million."
